conbody.p: New agent or clicking an existing agent opens the editor. Fields:

strow.stentry: claude-code, codex-cli, gemini-cli, anthropic-api, openai-api, google-api
Dropdown of the provider's known models, or provider default, or Custom… to type any model id the vendor accepts
Reasoning effort: low, medium, high, xhigh, max — or provider default. Applies to claude-code; codex-cli caps it at high; gemini-cli ignores it
proposal (changes need approval) or direct (writes immediately)
Allow runs that clone a connected repository
Cap on agentic turns per run
Comma-separated tool allowlist — required, see below

conbody.p: Existing agents also have a Raw markdown tab showing the underlying definition file (frontmatter + system prompt) for direct editing.
